title: FRÖSÖN/DUVHOLMEN chaise pad
description: FRÖSÖN/DUVHOLMEN chaise pad, dark gray, 743/4x235/8" Separate covers makes it easy to refresh your outdoor furniture when you like. These are made of recycled PET bottles and dyed in a more sustainable way, which also makes the color last longer in the sun. The zipper makes the cover easy to remove.
features: Use with FRÖSÖN cover for seat/back pad so that you have a spare cover when you want to change the look of the seat/back pad or when the seat/back pad needs to be washed.
May be completed with TOSTERÖ storage bag.
Fits SEGERÖN and NÄMMARÖ sun loungers.
If you do not want to use the elastic strap you can hide it in the small pocket on the side of the cushion.
The material in this product may be recyclable. Please check the recycling rules in your community and if recycling facilities exist in your area.
materialAndCare: Cover/ Smolder resistant lining: Polyester wadding; Filling: 100% polyester (min. 80% recycled); Core filling: Polyurethane foam; 100% polyester (min. 90% recycled)
